actor: Open-source LLM fine-tuning framework maintainer (Axolotl, TRL, Llama-Factory, torchtune, PEFT class)

motivation: Breakage-prone follow-on ports are what kept ROCm second-class; single-source portable kernels remove the weeks-behind lag.
